lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Monday's Town Council meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's new wildfire resilience requirements goes in front of elected officials — in a box canyon surrounded by fire country, that's not a routine item. Council will also hold a second work session on the Telluride Energy Mitigation program, and the Housing Authority meets the same evening to seat its new Resident Advisory Committee and fill positions by random drawing from tenant applicants across five properties.

notable.stake: First reading: wildfire resilience building-code changes affect how anything gets built here.
